B.name: Harim
B.line: A lay chief of the people who seals Nehemiah's covenant

first_reader_said: NEH 10:27: A, the house of Harim of Ezra 2:32, is already noted as sealing at 10:27, and B is that same lay sealer.

why: B is a thinner copy of the lay sealer in NEH 10:27, an occurrence already explicitly included in A's verses and notes. A additionally preserves the Harim family in EZR 2:32 and NEH 7:35 and the family connections in EZR 10:31 and NEH 3:11. B supplies no separate father, generation, or office that would distinguish another man.
